messages:
sasha: FYI planning a breaking-but-graceful change to the internal routing header shape. goal: move from verbose `X-Redwood-Route` JSON blob to a compact `rd-route` key/value encoding to reduce network noise and improve kernel parsing in the runtime. impacts: Python/TS/Go SDKs + console attribution. thoughts?
eric: quick q — how will this map to console route attribution? we currently parse the JSON blob for tenant/service/shard. need to keep the console route facets stable for billing and dashboards. :eyes:
maya: is an opt-in flag possible? some customers depend on exact header names for legacy proxies. would prefer `rd-route-v2` negotiation instead of immediate swap.
anil: +1 to negotiation. server-side should accept both for at least 90 days and surface a telemetry marker when v2 is used. can we also make the encoding deterministic (semicolon kv) so edge proxies can parse cheaply?
zoe: rollout UX note — console should show a per-tenant migration tile: pct traffic on v1/v2 and sampled examples. engineers want a single click to opt a tenant onto v2 for canary. otherwise ops will ping us.
julian: small gotcha for Go SDK: we construct headers via map[string]string and ordering is lost; if we switch to a compact single header we need to ensure we preserve stable encoding. suggest `service=chat;shard=3;route=short` canonicalization code shipped in SDKs.
sasha: agreed. proposed approach: server accepts both headers, logs a `route_header_migration` event with {from: v1|v2, tenant, sample_id}. SDKs ship v2 opt-in flag and stable encoder. timeline: publish spec next week, SDK PRs the following, opt-in canary after 2 weeks, full swap + deprecation 60 days after canary.
eric: telemetry mapping checklist: 1) console attribute names stay the same (tenant, service, shard, route_tags) 2) preserve sample_id for debug 3) add boolean `route_header_v2` to event indexed for queries.
maya: for backcompat sample: please provide `RD_ROUTE_LEGACY_FALLBACK` env var for infra to flip per-deployment. also publish a small migration guide (one-liner curl examples).
sasha: draft curl snippet for the guide:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \ 
     -H 'rd-route:service=chat;shard=3;tenant=acme' \ 
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
eric: perfect. also emit a deprecation header in responses for clients still using v1: `X-RD-Route-Deprecation: 2025-05-15`. ops can alert customers then.
anil: quota attribution: ensure legacy and v2 map to same quota buckets. otherwise billing glitches. we should include a shuffled hash of tenant+service to keep ledger sharding unchanged.
zoe: for canary UX: console tile should let you pick sample rate (0.1%/1%/10%/100%), preview sampled requests, and opt-in whole tenant. can we add a telemetry event for each opt? audit log req.
sasha: yes — audit + shipped telemetry. next steps I propose:
- spec PR (me) by Tue
- renderer + console tile mock (zoe) by Wed
- SDK opt-in PRs (maya/julian) start Thurs, keep legacy enabled by default
- infra: accept both headers + emit `route_header_migration` event (anil/eric)
- canary schedule after SDK prerelease: start in 2 weeks
- deprecate v1 header 60 days after canary goes 100%

maya: for Python/TS SDKs will add `rd_route_encoder.stable_encode()` and env var toggle. will include migration tests and a small e2e with console sink.
julian: Go SDK will implement canonical encoder + add `RD_ROUTE_LEGACY_FALLBACK` env var. will warn in logs when encoding used is v1.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: internal/route-header-compat  — CI green, scheduled deploy 2025-03-11T22:10:00Z :rocket:
eric: one more thing — telemetry sampling: track `route_header_v2` at ingestion with sampling rate 0.2% by default until we confirm no perf regressions. can bump if stable.
zoe: and add a console note explaining why sampled examples may not show all requests.
sasha: cool. I'll open the spec PR now and ping the SDK threads once it's up. thanks all. :party_popper:
